title: Top Tough Dog Toys for Heavy Chewers (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on mentions in CNET, Spots.com, Business Insider, and PupperCrust, with priority given to products cited by multiple sources.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a large, power‑chewing dog that can destroy most toys in minutes. The Kong Extreme is made from a tough, non‑nylon material that withstands heavy chewing and can be stuffed with treats to keep the dog engaged. Its only catch is that it can still be broken if the dog is extremely aggressive.
